exposure: weight loss of 5 kg or greater
low gestational weight gain (0 kg or greater and less than 5 kg)
adequate gestational weight gain (5 kg or greater to 9 kg or less)
excessive gestational weight gain (greater than 9 kg)
cohort: 18,053 liveborn singleton term (≥37 weeks gestation) births to obese women in Flanders, Belgium between 2009 and 2011
finding: Weight loss and low gestational weight gain in obese pregnant women were associated with a decreased incidence of gestational hypertension (class I obesity), emergency cesarean delivery (class II obesity), and macrosomia and large-for-gestational-age neonates (all classes), but not with low birth weight or small-for-gestational-age neonates.
